_comment: Pagine associazione seminate da MIRA per l'Università Bocconi.
Schede scritte a mano da fonti pubbliche (sito ufficiale dell'associazione + elenco
ufficiale Bocconi), non generate. Ogni riga porta le fonti in source_urls.
Nessun dato personale: solo l'organizzazione. Nessun logo scaricato.
Voce: prima persona plurale, in inglese, come le pagine scritte dai presidenti veri
(vedi Bocconi Students Blockchain Association e Bocconi Students for Value Investing).
Struttura volutamente diversa da scheda a scheda: divisioni, elenchi o prosa.

associations.name: Aleph - Analisi Strategiche
associations.short_description: Founded in 2013, the first association in Italy dedicated to foreign policy, intelligence and defence.
associations.long_description:
We were founded in 2013 and we are the first association in Italy dedicated to foreign policy, intelligence and defence, subjects that are usually discussed everywhere except where students can practise them.

What we are after is four things. Building real methodological skills through training, seminars and research. Partnerships with companies working on security. Contact with research centres, institutions and specialist media. And a generation that understands both the opportunities and the dangers of an increasingly multipolar world.

Members develop their analysis through our own publication, online debates and regular meetings.

associations.name: Associazione Studentesca Letteraria Bocconi d'Inchiostro
associations.short_description: Literature at Bocconi since 2012, including a national poetry competition and the first literary prize run by an Italian student association.
associations.long_description:
We were founded in 2012 around reading and the critical analysis of texts, in prose and in verse, and around what literature has to say about civil society and even about legal and economic questions.

We run seminars and conferences, present books and host their authors. Every year we hold a national poetry competition. We run Biblioscambio, a book exchange inside the university. And we award the Dante d'Oro, the first literary prize created by an Italian student association.

associations.name: Bocconi Economics Student Association
associations.short_description: The main economics association at Bocconi. We argue about global news and publish original research every week.
associations.long_description:
We are the main economics association at Bocconi, for students interested in international economics, finance and politics, and in the places where the three meet.

Most of what we do starts as an argument: global news, social issues, economic questions where the answer is not obvious. What comes out of it gets written up as original research and published weekly on our website.

Alongside that we bring in prominent economists and faculty for events open to anyone who wants to come.

associations.name: Bocconi Student Association for Mathematical Sciences
associations.short_description: The first mathematics association at Bocconi, building a community around maths and the research that comes out of it.
associations.long_description:
We are the first mathematics association at Bocconi, and what we are building is a community for students who are serious about maths, connected to the Decision Sciences department and to research opportunities.

We are organised in four divisions, each with its own board and its own activities: Mathematics, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, covering decision theory, game theory and mathematical economics, and Physics.

We also run preparation sessions for mathematics competitions such as the ICMC, so that Bocconi can compete against universities that have been doing this far longer.

Applications go through a form on our site, and the selection asks candidates exactly one question.

associations.name: Bocconi Students - Advocacy & Litigation
associations.short_description: The largest law association at Bocconi, running since 2012. Moot courts, real trials, and the gap between law in books and law in action.
associations.long_description:
We started in 2012 and we are the largest and most active law students association at Bocconi. The idea we work from is the distance between law in books and law in action, and how to cross it while still at university.

Moot courts are the core: students argue simulated proceedings against each other, properly. Around them we run conferences with experts across commercial, criminal, intellectual property and international law, publish articles and essays, meet lawyers, judges and corporate legal teams, and run workshops inside law firms.

We also go and watch real trials at the Milan courthouse, and every year around fifteen of us spend five days at a university abroad studying a specific area of law.

Underneath all of it we are a group of friends with the same interests, and that is not a detail.

associations.name: Bocconi Students against Organized Crime
associations.short_description: The first association at Bocconi dedicated to organised crime and what it does to the economy, politics and society.
associations.long_description:
We are the first association at Bocconi built specifically around organised crime, and what it does to economies, politics and societies in Italy and internationally.

We want to be the place where Bocconi students can put their own skills into projects, studies and serious research on this subject, instead of treating it as somebody else's field.

In practice that means initiatives and events, debates with people who work on this professionally, and research we carry out ourselves. The subject sits across economics, law and social activism.

We select new members twice a year, and what we care about is what each member can actually do inside the association.
associations.recruiting_timeline: New members selected twice a year.

associations.name: Bocconi Students Asset Management Club
associations.short_description: We research the asset management industry and publish what we find, across two divisions: Market Insights and Asset Management.
associations.long_description:
We started in 2020, founded by international students, and that mix of backgrounds is still the thing we rely on most.

Our work is research, and two divisions produce it.

MARKET INSIGHTS
What is moving equity markets, and why it matters to somebody managing money.

ASSET MANAGEMENT
Investment strategies, client profiling and asset allocation, taken apart in detail.

Both publish articles and reports regularly, written hands-on rather than summarised from somewhere else. What we are building around the research is a network of students and professionals in the industry that reaches well outside Italy.

associations.name: Bocconi Students Capital Markets
associations.short_description: We write about finance in the broadest sense, from investment banking to asset management, hedge funds and private equity, with teams covering the Americas, EMEA and Asia.
associations.long_description:
We were the first association at Bocconi to take the word finance in its widest meaning: investment banking, asset management, hedge funds and private equity all belong here, and anyone who wants to write and argue about them has a place.

Most of what we do ends up published. Our members produce articles and analysis on global financial markets, organised in three teams by region: Americas, EMEA and Asia.

Alongside the writing, a good part of our work goes into preparing the members who are aiming at investment banking: M&A cases, mock interviews, and time spent with people who already do the job.

associations.name: Bocconi Students Consulting Club
associations.short_description: The oldest and largest consulting club in Italy. We train our members to crack cases and to land the job they are aiming for.
associations.long_description:
We are the association for students who want a career in strategy consulting, and we are the oldest and largest consulting club in Italy.

What we actually do:

We visit consulting firms and meet the people who work there.
We run training sessions on frameworks, models and the skills you need to crack a business case.
We organise networking events with professionals in the industry.

We are 70 members from ten different nationalities. Getting in means passing our selection, which we run twice a year, around September and March.
associations.recruiting_timeline: Two selection rounds a year, usually in September and March.

associations.name: Bocconi Students Distressed Investing & Restructuring Society
associations.short_description: Europe's first undergraduate club focused on restructuring and distressed investments.
associations.long_description:
We are the first undergraduate club in Europe built around restructuring and distressed investing: the part of finance that deals with companies under pressure rather than companies where everything is going well.

CORPORATE FINANCE
Capital markets, mergers and acquisitions, valuation.

SPECIAL SITUATIONS & PRIVATE EQUITY
Leveraged buyouts and turnaround strategies.

CREDIT INVESTMENTS
Fixed income and credit risk.

Around the divisions we run technical training led by the division heads, mock interviews, workshops with firms in the sector and networking with people who do this for a living.

associations.name: Bocconi Students Finance Society
associations.short_description: Since 2013 we have put Bocconi students in the same room as the people running the financial industry.
associations.long_description:
We started at the beginning of 2013 with a simple idea: create a place where ambitious Bocconi students and senior people from the financial industry can actually talk to each other.

That happens through presentations, panels on what is moving markets right now, and networking sessions where the conversation continues after the talk ends.

associations.name: Bocconi Students Fintech Society
associations.short_description: The leading fintech association at Bocconi. We research the companies that are changing financial services, and we work entirely in English.
associations.long_description:
We bring together students who want to understand where finance is going, and we do it by researching the companies that are changing financial services rather than discussing them in the abstract.

What we produce is high-level research on fintech topics, shared inside and outside the association. Around it we build relationships with the fintech ecosystem, so that curiosity turns into something usable when it is time to choose a career.

All our activities run in English.

associations.name: Bocconi Students for Alternative Investments
associations.short_description: Founded in 2023 and already the largest alternative investments association at Bocconi: 72 members across nine divisions.
associations.long_description:
We started in 2023, and in two years we have become the largest association at Bocconi dedicated to alternative investments: 72 members, nine divisions, more than fifty reports published.

The divisions are Hedge Funds, Private Equity, Private Credit, Real Estate, Venture Capital, Quant, Energy and Infrastructure, Media and Operations.

Four things hold the work together. We connect students to the industry through events, seminars and workshops. We build the technical and analytical skills that each sector actually asks for. We put educational resources and mentorship in front of people who are starting out. And we keep a community where you can work out whether this career is for you before committing to it.

associations.name: Bocconi Students for ESG
associations.short_description: We study how ESG principles get built into financial, corporate and legislative models, rather than bolted onto them.
associations.long_description:
We started from a conviction: sustainable development only happens if non-financial ESG principles are actually included in how decisions are made, not added at the end as a report.

So our work is study. How ESG principles get integrated into financial models, into how companies are run, and into legislation. And discussion of how firms can genuinely become more sustainable inside an economy that keeps shifting under them.

What we are after is that the people who will be leading tomorrow understand why this matters before it is their decision to make.

associations.name: Bocconi Students for Fashion and Luxury
associations.short_description: Since 2013 we connect Bocconi students to the fashion industry, including a consulting team that works with fashion firms.
associations.long_description:
We started in September 2013 as the first student organisation at Bocconi dedicated to fashion, and the aim has not changed: connect students to the industry, and give them the professional skills and the critical eye that working in it requires.

We run conferences, workshops, company visits and networking events with people from the industry. We also have a consulting team that supports fashion firms on research projects, which is where the learning gets real.

We are around thirty students, and we publish business analysis on our blog.

associations.name: Bocconi Students for Hospitality Management
associations.short_description: Hospitality in all its forms: hotels, food and beverage, tourism. Founded in 2025, organised in four departments.
associations.long_description:
We work on the hospitality industry in all its forms: hotels, food and beverage, tourism. We were founded in 2025, so we are among the newest associations at Bocconi.

INDUSTRY ANALYSIS, HOTELLERIE
Research on how the hotel industry actually works.

INDUSTRY ANALYSIS, F&B
The food and beverage side, analysed the same way.

EVENTS
What we open to our members and to the wider university.

SOCIAL MEDIA
How our work reaches people.

What we produce ranges from case studies and articles to events with professionals, and the point of all of it is getting our members into real contact with companies and the people inside them.

associations.name: Bocconi Students for Machine Learning
associations.short_description: The machine learning association at Bocconi. We build a network across tech companies, funds and research labs, and we ship projects.
associations.long_description:
We are the leading machine learning student association at Bocconi. Our aim is a network of minds spanning the best tech companies, investment funds and research labs, and using it to accelerate the careers of the people in it.

We design and run events: research talks, company sessions, project showcases, dinners with guests.
We set up partnerships: talks, hackathons, projects, interviews.
We publish what comes out of it, as articles, videos and presentations.

If you are working on something of your own, we help you carry it through: the code, the way you tell it, and getting it published.

associations.name: Bocconi Students for Real Estate
associations.short_description: Real estate at Bocconi: virtual investment portfolios, simulations, and events with the people who work in the market.
associations.long_description:
We work on the real estate market, and we do it practically. We plan investments and build virtual property portfolios, and we run simulations of the decisions people in this industry make for real.

Alongside that we open educational events with specialists in the market to the whole Bocconi community, not only to our own members.

We are around twenty, with a board of nine.

associations.name: Bocconi Students for Venture Capital
associations.short_description: Venture capital, startups and innovation. We connect Bocconi students to the people who fund and build companies.
associations.long_description:
We work on venture capital, startups and the innovation landscape around them, with one aim: getting Bocconi students genuinely connected to the VC ecosystem rather than reading about it.

BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT
Partnerships with funds, startups and accelerators, and the events, webinars and competitions that come out of them.

VENTURE CAPITAL
Projects with players in the industry, advising early-stage startups, supporting VCs on their own work.

ARTICLES
Analysis of where venture capital is heading.

MEDIA
Our channels, the weekly newsletter and the website.

We recruit on a rolling basis.

associations.name: Bocconi Students International Law Society
associations.short_description: The first law society in Italy focused on the international side of law, and on the bridge between legal and economic subjects.
associations.long_description:
We are the first law students society in Italy built around the international dimension of law, for people who want to do something with that interest rather than keep it theoretical.

We work as an interdisciplinary bridge between the traditional subjects of legal study and economics, which is the same approach the Bocconi law degree itself takes.

In practice that means academic seminars and conferences, international events run together with the Bocconi School of Law, and initiatives for students aiming at international careers. And a place where ideas about multidisciplinary approaches to law can be shared without formality.

associations.name: Bocconi Students Investment Club
associations.short_description: We are the oldest finance association at Bocconi. Since 2010 we have been writing research on the markets, and we still do, every week.
associations.long_description:
We started in 2010 and received the University's official recognition in April 2011, which makes us the oldest finance student association at Bocconi.

Around 60 of us are active at any given time, working across three divisions.

CORPORATE FINANCE
Deal analysis and company valuation, from the mechanics of a transaction to the numbers behind it.

MARKETS
Coverage of what moves global markets, published as research on our website.

QUANT
Quantitative approaches to pricing, strategy and risk, for members who want the technical side of finance.

We recruit several times during the academic year, and we are open to any student enrolled at Bocconi.
associations.recruiting_timeline: Several recruiting sessions during the academic year.

associations.name: Bocconi Students M&A Circle
associations.short_description: Since 2014 we have done one thing: mergers and acquisitions. Deal analysis, valuation workshops, and the preparation that gets you through an interview.
associations.long_description:
We have been running since 2014, entirely student-led, for people who want to work in mergers and acquisitions.

We take apart recent deals and rebuild the reasoning behind them. We run valuation workshops where you do the work rather than watch it. We bring in guests from the industry, and we sit down with members on CVs, cover letters and interview preparation, the unglamorous part that decides most outcomes.

We are around 35 students, split evenly between bachelor and master, with eleven nationalities among us. We recruit twice a year, in October and in March.
associations.recruiting_timeline: Two recruiting rounds a year, in October and March.

associations.name: Bocconi Students Marketing Society
associations.short_description: Marketing at Bocconi, across four departments: consulting projects, digital, events and partnerships.
associations.long_description:
We work on marketing and communication, a field that matters as much to a multinational as it does to a start-up, and we are organised in four departments.

CONSULTING
Projects for companies, run by our members.

DIGITAL
Digital media and communication, where most of marketing now happens.

EVENTS
The moments that bring students, alumni, faculty and professionals into the same room.

PARTNERSHIP
The relationships with the companies we work with.

What holds it together is the network: we want our members to leave knowing people, not just concepts.

associations.name: Bocconi Students Private Equity Club
associations.short_description: One of the oldest associations at Bocconi, focused on private equity and venture capital in Italy and abroad.
associations.long_description:
We are one of the oldest and most active student associations at Bocconi, and our attention sits on two industries: private equity and venture capital, in Italy and internationally.

We publish articles on private equity and venture capital.
We interview professionals who work in the industry.
We run events with funds, advisors and academics.
We hold educational workshops for our members.

Our meetings run throughout the academic year, and most of them come back to the same question: what has actually changed in this industry recently, and why.

associations.name: Bocconi Students Women in Finance
associations.short_description: A platform for female students heading into financial services, and a network of more than 80 alumnae already working in the industry.
associations.long_description:
We exist to make collaboration easier among female students who want a career in financial services, and to turn it into something that lasts beyond university: more than eighty of our alumnae now work in leading financial institutions across Europe, North America and Asia.

We meet weekly to discuss markets, present to each other and spend time together. Around that we run events with professionals from the industry, networking sessions, and workshops and mentoring programmes on both technical and soft skills.

What we care about is cooperation rather than competition. Applications open at the start of each semester and are welcome from any major, as long as the interest in finance is real.
associations.recruiting_timeline: Applications open at the beginning of each semester.

associations.name: Build Sustainable Innovation
associations.short_description: Students working on the economics and management of innovation, across five divisions including consulting for startups and SMEs.
associations.long_description:
We are a group of students interested in the economics and management of innovation and technology, and our job is connecting students, faculty and companies around it.

CONSULTING
Projects for startups and SMEs on market analysis, business planning, marketing strategy and user experience testing. Each project has a lead and four or five members.

TECH
Data analytics in real settings: sentiment analysis, machine learning, IoT, business intelligence. We support multinationals on big data work and run crash courses with technology companies.

EVENTS
Conferences with outside speakers, company visits and private workshops, built on a network of tech companies and entrepreneurs.

DIGITAL
Marketing and branding, from web editing to graphic design and social media.

NIMS
The Italian chapter of an international network, with seminars, workshops and career-focused projects for master students in innovation management.

associations.name: Business&Arts
associations.short_description: Where art meets management and finance: how works get valued, and who the economic players in the art world actually are.
associations.long_description:
We look at the point where art, management and finance meet, which is a place most people interested in art never get shown.

We run conferences with people from cultural institutions, galleries and auction houses, and we publish on the subjects that come out of them: the relationship between artists and curators, how a work of art gets valued, and who the economic actors in this market really are.

We are a group of international students held together by an interest in the business of art, and what we organise is open to the whole Bocconi community.

associations.name: Dawn Advisory
associations.short_description: Student consulting for startups, across three campuses: Milan, Barcelona and Hong Kong. 85 members, more than 30 nationalities.
associations.long_description:
We bring student consulting to startups, and we do it from three places at once: Bocconi in Milan, ESADE in Barcelona and HKUST in Hong Kong.

Our work sits in four areas: market validation, industry analysis, growth strategy, and evaluating funding options.

We are 85 active members representing more than thirty nationalities, and we have worked with companies including Bitpanda, N26 and Nike.

We recruit continuously, with applications handled separately by each of the three branches.
associations.recruiting_timeline: Rolling recruiting, handled by each branch.

associations.name: Economic Society for Bocconi Students
associations.short_description: Around sixty students who take economics seriously. Weekly internal seminars, open seminars with faculty, and a thesis award.
associations.long_description:
We exist to push critical, rigorous but genuinely innovative thinking in the social sciences, and to get people arguing about economics properly rather than casually.

Every week we run an internal seminar where members present economic work to each other. Alongside those we hold open seminars with Bocconi professors and outside guests, public events with economists and policy-makers, and initiatives such as the Economic Society Thesis Award.

We are a community of around sixty undergraduate and graduate students. We take in new members twice a year, at the start of each academic semester, and anyone who wants to discuss economics in an informal but demanding environment is welcome.
associations.recruiting_timeline: New members twice a year, at the start of each semester.

associations.name: Entrepreneurship Club Bocconi Students
associations.short_description: The association of Bocconi students who are building something. A place to develop your project surrounded by people doing the same.
associations.long_description:
We are the association of student entrepreneurs at Bocconi. The point is to have an environment where people building something can support each other and experiment freely, instead of doing it alone.

Our members work at startups, run their own projects, or are involved in a family business. Our themes sit across economics and management, entrepreneurship, and technology and innovation.

If you are not building anything yet there is still plenty to do: organising activities, planning events, keeping the network in the local ecosystem alive. Active participation is what makes this club work.

associations.name: ESN Milano Bocconi - Erasmus Student Network
associations.short_description: The Bocconi section of the Erasmus Student Network: we welcome exchange students and get them into the life of the city.
associations.long_description:
We are the Bocconi section of an international network that exists for exchange students. When someone arrives here on Erasmus, we are the people who help them work out both the university and the city.

That splits in two. There is the practical support, academic and otherwise, for students who have just landed. And there is everything that turns arriving into belonging: social events, cultural activities, sport, and trips around Italy.

We are Italian and international students together, and a good part of us joined after our own exchange, because it is a way of staying inside that kind of environment instead of leaving it behind.

associations.name: European Generation
associations.short_description: Founded in 2013 to understand how the European Union actually works, and to argue about where it should go.
associations.long_description:
We were founded in 2013 to do something that sounds simple and is not: understand how the European Union is actually built and governed, and rediscover the ideas the whole project started from.

We work through debates, events, publications and multimedia projects, across current affairs and geopolitics, public administration and the non-profit sector, and economic and political thought.

What we are is a multicultural community, and also a training ground: the debate is the point, but so is what it does to the people taking part in it.

associations.name: Family Business Association
associations.short_description: Around 90% of Italian companies are family-run. We are the reference point at Bocconi for understanding how they work.
associations.long_description:
Roughly nine out of ten Italian companies are family-run, and that fact shapes an enormous part of the economy our members will work in. We exist to make that subject something you can actually study and practise at Bocconi.

We work on strategic and managerial advisory, and on the legal and tax side of family companies. We run public events, meetings with academics and professionals, and company visits.

The topics we keep returning to are governance, internationalisation and generational handover, the moment where most family companies either grow or break.

One thing we care about: what our members contribute along the way counts as much as the final result.

associations.name: Green Light for Business
associations.short_description: The main sustainability association at Bocconi, founded in 2008 by international students. Four divisions, from research to campus projects.
associations.long_description:
We are the main sustainability association at Bocconi. We were founded in 2008 by international students, and we work on circular economy, green innovation and the companies trying to build businesses around both.

KNOWLEDGE & RESEARCH
The research itself.

BLOGS & REPORTS
Getting it out in a form people read.

GREEN CAMPUS & EVENTS
Conferences, workshops and projects that change something on campus rather than only on paper.

SOCIAL MEDIA
Our voice outside the university.

What we want is to get people genuinely involved in green business, and to prepare the ones who will be making these decisions with both the economic and the environmental side in view.

associations.name: IUS@B
associations.short_description: The only association at Bocconi dedicated exclusively to law students, run peer to peer.
associations.long_description:
We were born in March 2019 as the representative list for law students and became an official association that September. We are the only one at Bocconi dedicated exclusively to the needs of its law students.

We promote interest in law through events, conferences, seminars, debates and networking, including on subjects that are in the news right now rather than only in the syllabus.

The way we work is peer to peer: students in different years supporting each other, which for a degree like this one turns out to matter more than any single event we organise.

associations.name: JEME Bocconi Studenti
associations.short_description: The first junior enterprise in Italy, running since 1988. We do consulting work for real clients, done by students.
associations.long_description:
We were founded in 1988 and we are the first junior enterprise in Italy. What we do is consulting: real projects for real clients, run in teams, where what you studied has to survive contact with a company that is paying for an answer.

Alongside the projects we run training aimed at the two things the work demands: the technical side, and the ability to deal with people. More than three decades in, that combination is still the reason people join.

We recruit twice a year, in autumn and in spring, through our website. What we look for is passion, willingness to be challenged, and the ability to work with others.
associations.recruiting_timeline: Two recruiting rounds a year, in autumn and in spring.

associations.name: Luxury Bocconi Students Society
associations.short_description: The only association at Bocconi dedicated entirely to the luxury industry, in all its forms. Around 50 members across five divisions.
associations.long_description:
We are the first and only association at Bocconi dedicated entirely and exclusively to the luxury industry. What we try to do is put the people leading that industry today in the same room as the people who will lead it next.

We are around fifty, organised in divisions by sector: Fashion & Accessories, Watches, Jewellery & Arts, Cars & Transports, and Lifestyle.

On top of the divisions, members can work in three cross-cutting departments: Communications, Events and Public Relations.

associations.name: Minerva Investment Management Society
associations.short_description: The first asset management society at Bocconi. We run three proprietary funds and produce the research behind them.
associations.long_description:
We are the first and leading asset management student association at Bocconi University. Around 70 of us work across five divisions, and the divisions feed each other: the research decides what the funds do.

PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT
We manage three proprietary funds across a wide range of asset classes and investment products, applying our own macro outlooks and investment strategies, with the aim of stable income and long-term capital growth.

QUANTITATIVE
We measure the risk sitting inside our portfolios, using VaR methodologies, bootstrapping and portfolio optimisation.

EQUITY RESEARCH
We value companies across a wide pool of names, with DCF, multiples, DDM and LBO models.

MACRO RESEARCH
We follow macroeconomic news and market trends, and turn them into a view.

INVESTMENT RESEARCH
We identify the most attractive asset classes given current conditions, and publish monthly outlooks and reports.

associations.name: Students for Humanity
associations.short_description: Since 2011 the platform for every socially minded initiative at Bocconi: volunteering, fundraising, awareness campaigns.
associations.long_description:
We were founded in 2011 to carry solidarity and social responsibility inside Bocconi, and over time we became the platform through which most socially minded initiatives here happen.

We organise events, fundraising and awareness campaigns, and forums on the social questions that are pressing right now. We run the permanent volunteering guidance desk together with CIESSEVI, we support the projects of international NGOs in developing countries, and we bring in leaders from international cooperation to speak.

We are open to everyone. There is no profile you need to match, only an interest in the subject.

associations.name: Tortuga Studenti Bocconi
associations.short_description: The first Italian think tank made of young researchers and students. Over 400 articles and 40 projects on Italian policy.
associations.long_description:
We are the first Italian think tank made up of young researchers and students in economics and the social sciences, and we work on Italian policy questions: labour, public finance, education, environment, territorial development, thirteen subject areas in all.

What we produce is independent analysis, written to be rigorous and readable at the same time, and concrete policy proposals that could actually be implemented. We also take on research and advisory work for institutions, companies and policy-makers.

So far that has meant more than 400 articles and over 40 projects, alongside events, a policy paper competition and a newsletter. We are around thirty active members with sixty alumni.

associations.name: Women in Business
associations.short_description: The first women's association at Bocconi, connecting current students and alumnae into one professional network.
associations.long_description:
We are the first women's association at Bocconi, and our work is to raise awareness of women empowerment by building a professional network that connects students now with alumnae already in the industry.

We do it three ways. We bring in entrepreneurs and leaders to tell their stories in person. We organise visits to companies that take this subject seriously. And we run the association through the active participation of our members at every level, which is itself the training.

The fields we focus on are consulting, finance and entrepreneurship.
